understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a corresponding goal tile marked '+'. If there were multiple goals, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be selected and moved using directional actions or by clicking a destination. Movement was constrained by walls and obstacles; blocked clicks produced no movement. Pieces could push obstacles or other movable objects when the path allowed it, but could not pass through impassable walls. The number of actions was limited, so efficient path planning and maintaining the correct piece selection were important.
